title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27.1): Print the Audit Trail report (report 330 “Audit Trail”)
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 2 introduces a new Audit Trail report that provides a comprehensive, transparent record of all transactions by displaying data from the G/L Register and G/L Entry tables to enhance compliance and transaction traceability.
key_points: New Audit Trail report (report 330) added in BC27.1 for improved compliance
Shows detailed transaction information from G/L Register and G/L Entry tables
Helps auditors and internal teams verify accurate recording and trace transactions
Provides transparent documentation of all financial transactions

quotes.text: The new Audit Trail report feature enhances compliance by providing a comprehensive and transparent record of all transactions.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core business value of the feature for regulatory and audit purposes
